options.label: Backlog + ref sections by anchor (Recommended)
options.description: Item/dossier/outline lookup, plus any CLAUDE-REFERENCE section by anchor and ripple rows by trigger. Covers the measured traffic: 17 of 24 ref reads were PR gates/freshness/interview/I-O sections, not ripple rows.

options.label: Both, ripple rows only
options.description: Backlog lookup plus ripple rows by trigger, as originally framed. Misses the dominant ref reads (PR validation gates, branch freshness), which keep their grep-then-slice cycle.

options.label: Backlog lookup only
options.description: Smallest tool: item by ID, text find, DONE outline. CLAUDE-REFERENCE untouched; its 'unclear/misleading' tags (28) stay unaddressed.

options.label: Ripple rows only
options.description: Only `ref-rows <trigger>`. Serves 7 of 24 measured ref reads; backlog's 57 sliced reads unchanged.

options.label: New script, shared grammar (Recommended)
options.description: `scripts/sdd_lookup.py` with hatch aliases (`backlog-show`, `backlog-find`, `ref-show`), importing `_HEADER_RE`/`_sections` from gen_backlogid so the item grammar stays single-homed. gen_backlogid stays a pure gate.

options.label: Extend gen_backlogid.py
options.description: New subcommands on the existing script. No new file, but mixes a reader into a gate that carries six Drift-gate blocks and a regenerate-on-no-flag default (the --help pitfall).

options.label: Skill wrapping the script
options.description: Script as in option 1, plus a `/lookup` skill. The skill costs its own prompt load per invocation, which on a 200-token answer is most of the spend.

questions.question: Should skills and CLAUDE.md point sessions at the tool?

options.label: Skills at lookup steps only (Recommended)
options.description: Replace grep/slice instructions in pr, fix-pr, rvw-pr, ship, orchestrate where a step fetches one section or item; keep links to the files as the authority. CLAUDE.md gets one line in Dev commands, not a rule.

options.label: Skills and a CLAUDE.md rule
options.description: Same skill edits, plus a Backlog-section rule 'query by key, don't grep'. Stronger nudge, but adds an always-loaded instruction every session pays for.

options.label: No pointers yet
options.description: Ship the tool, measure adoption from transcripts first. Likely near-zero uptake: sessions follow the skill text they're given.

questions.question: How should the tool relate to DRIFT-RULES?

options.label: Docstring bounds, no Drift-gate block (Recommended)
options.description: It compares nothing, so it is not a drift mechanism; a block would put a lookup into GATE-INVENTORY. State Rule 7 bounds in the docstring anyway, and name it outside check_/gen_/drift_/report_ so the wiring gate does not demand a block.

options.label: Declare a 'surfaces' block
options.description: Add a Drift-gate block declaring what it surfaces, so it appears in GATE-INVENTORY as advisory. Discoverable there, but inflates an inventory meant for disagreement detectors.

options.label: Add a parse self-check
options.description: Also a `--check` that fails when a file shape the tool depends on (anchors, row cells) stops parsing, wired into docs-gate. A real cross-artifact gate with a block; more to build and maintain.
